title: Watch: 2020 Democrats Blast Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu Ahead Of Israel Election | NBC News
description:
Bernie Sanders said Prime Minister Netanyahu “always tries going even further to the right by appealing to racism within Israel.” Beto O’Rourke explicitly labeled Netanyahu a “racist” at a weekend campaign event in Iowa. And Pete Buttigieg tweeted he does not agree with the prime minister's politics regarding the West Bank.
